title: An oracle separating nondeterministic and deterministic polynomial time
statement: There exists a language $B$ of binary strings such that the language consisting of strings $1^n$ for which some binary string of length $n$ belongs to $B$ is in nondeterministic polynomial time relative to oracle $B$, but is not in deterministic polynomial time relative to oracle $B$.
